# @liha-labs/holiday

> Official-data Japanese holiday library for TypeScript.

## Links

- [Documentation](https://holiday.liha.dev/)
- [Full Documentation for AI](https://holiday.liha.dev/llms-full.txt)
- [Repository](https://github.com/liha-labs/holiday)

## Features

- Official-data first (no holiday calculation logic)
- Strict input validation (`YYYY-MM-DD`, `YYYY-MM`)
- `holidayName` / `isHoliday` / `getHoliday` / `list*`
- `weekday` is attached at runtime
- `createClient` for `remoteBaseUrl` / `fetch` / `cache`
- `@liha-labs/holiday/full` entry

## Usage Summary

```ts
import { holidayName, getHoliday, listMonth } from '@liha-labs/holiday'

const name = await holidayName('2026-01-01')
const detail = await getHoliday('2026-01-01')
const jan = await listMonth('2026-01')
```
